figurative_meaning_en: Selection and judgment of merits and demerits, right and wrong, good and bad
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের ব্যাপারে বাছবিচার করে সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া উচিত।
কাজ বাছবিচার করে নাও, না হলে পরে পস্তাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: One should make a decision after careful selection and judgment in matters of marriage.
Choose your work with discernment, or you'll regret it later.
note: This idiom is commonly used in traditional Bengali contexts, particularly in familial decisions.
